controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-11T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T00:00:00.000Z"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 10
